err.no_vault: No vault available. Pass a folder, or add `vaults = [...]` to {path}
usage:
herdr-obsidian [vault]

vault: folder to add to the vault list and open it.
The list is kept in config.toml (vaults = [...]).
Language: HERDR_OBSIDIAN_LANG, then lang in config.toml, then the OS language, then en.
